title: Rldcoin: Interstellar Peer-to-Peer Payments
authorization_scope: Owner goal: complete the whitepaper; carry forward authorized PDF and official website synchronization. Define the remaining mechanisms, conditional arguments, finite encoding/resource and failure rules. No runtime or launch.

native_currency.name: runlai
native_currency.currency_identity: C_RLD binds one common authenticated genesis and monetary policy.

issuance.placement: Public proportional-work ClaimRange selects 1..256 unconsumed slots under stable grant G. Splits preserve G and existing Mint frontiers in unrelated source residuals. Prepared ranges enter independent controllers; installation or certified return gives only those slots a new grant. No parent-wide work invalidation or budget copying.
issuance.bootstrap: D_0 is an explicitly accepted initial quorum and availability dependency; no claim of Sybil-free equal distribution or trust-free consensus.

work_profile.purpose: Public issuance/distribution only; not validator votes or global monetary history selection. Claim work earns no RLD and does not replace Mint.

payment_fees.source: Exact owner-authorized existing balances and verified prior Mint payout policy. No subsidy or new issuance. Preparation charges remain paid after cancellation.

mechanisms: Stable grant-bound placement work survives unrelated splits; mutable segment boundaries are not work identity.
Finite source-bound capabilities leave future inputs unspecified and require certified funded reservations.
Native Prepare commits exact escrow and Delegated(x); historical creation proving continues under native extension.
Independent one-decision PBFT controller: Exported with ready receipt/material OR Canceled with direct bounded authorization execution. Canceled needs no recursive receipt before QC.
One native cancellation redemption closes the coupon; after Exported only certified permanent destination rejection permits recovery.
Immutable acceptance covers verify all actual ancestry recursively. Same-cover continuation avoids per-epoch vectors; signed inclusion-proved broadening and evidence-requiring narrowing are distinct.
Original controller keys and locks persist across native handoff; separate validated public key pools and one-use indices.
Typed deterministic CBOR, checked integers/roots/counts, exact ownership, full checkpoint commitments and noncircular creation/terminal identities.
Funded queues/custody/renewal with retained service-deficit obligations; no insolvency or time-based refund.
Normal bounded neighbor discovery and store-carry-forward scheduling; route identity/custody remains distinct from monetary authority.

proof_reference.required_monetary_binding: Exact trusted verifier/control root, hash/parameters, guest image IDs, successful unconditional claim, full journal codec and resource limits must be authenticated by the monetary descriptor.

equations: U + F + B + Q + Z = C
conservation.conditions: Valid native/controller execution, sound resolved recursive receipts, exclusive PBFT histories, available current data, original controller custody and permanent redemption/terminal maps. U includes preparation escrow; Q includes prepared unissued slots. Covers do not alter amounts.

mechanism_review.scope: Completed author source/counterexample and manuscript review, not an executed protocol proof or independent security audit.

claims: Completed manuscript defining conditional construction, canonical objects, transitions and safety/progress arguments. No completed monetary implementation, qualified guest, measured performance, mainnet or guaranteed impact.
limitations: PBFT threshold compromise can certify unseen separately valid forks; proof validity is not global ordering.
RLD guests, concrete verifier/program commitments, correctness and proving costs require implementation and independent analysis before monetary use.
Controllers consume finite resources and retain their original quorum; unavailable control can strand prepared escrow.

Broad covers deliberately trade exact attribution for bounded current acceptance and may quarantine all covered value. Narrowing needs further evidence; arbitrary new families are not automatically accepted.
Current state, permanent maps and audit custody retain costs; finite reserves do not finance infinite service.
Unknown source/coupon depletion requires setup. Physical contacts and finite cryptographic horizons remain prerequisites.
Public work is hardware-weighted, fairly bounded admission is assumed, and no calendar issuance date or CPU profit is guaranteed.
implementation_boundary: No protocol/node source, live network, monetary genesis, keys, asset balances, test-value migration or adoption policy is changed. Prior receipts and implementation obligations retain their original scope.
